briefTitle: Study of INBRX-106 and INBRX-106 in Combination With Pembrolizumab (Keytruda®) in Subjects With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors (Hexavalent OX40 Agonist)

typedChecks.sourceText: All subjects with non-squamous NSCLC must have documentation of absence of tumor activating EGFR mutations and absence of ALK gene rearrangements.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For Cohort F3 (NSCLC), subjects may have progressed on no more than 2 lines of standard therapy that must include at least one PD-1/L1 regimen.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific prior therapy and line limits apply only to a subset of subjects and cannot be expressed as a single global prior lines or prior therapy check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For Cohort F4 (HNSCC and NPC), subjects may be previously treated with no more than 1 prior chemotherapy regimen in metastatic setting.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific prior therapy limits apply only to specific non-NSCLC cohorts.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Combined Positive Score (CPS) ≥ 1% (or Tumor Proportion Score ≥50% for NSCLC; for TMB-high tumors, any TPS% is allowed).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: PD-L1 cutoffs vary by part and alternate between CPS and TPS depending on tumor type, making it too complex for a single typed pdl1_min check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate hematologic, coagulation, hepatic and renal function and ECOG score as defined per protocol.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific lab values and ECOG cutoffs are not explicitly listed in the source text and are deferred to the protocol.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Receipt of any investigational product or any approved anticancer drug(s) or biological product(s) within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of study drug with certain exceptions.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window with protocol-defined exceptions cannot be represented as a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior or concurrent malignancies. Exception: Subjects with a prior or concurrent malignancy whose natural history or treatment does not have the potential to interfere with the safety or efficacy assessments of INBRX-106.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Subjective clinical judgment regarding whether a prior or concurrent malignancy interferes with safety or efficacy assessments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Grade ≥ 3 immune-related adverse events (irAEs) or irAE that lead to discontinuation of prior immunotherapy. Some exceptions as defined per protocol apply.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion involves specific toxicity grades and protocol-defined exceptions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active autoimmune disease or documented history of autoimmune disease that required systemic steroids or other immunosuppressive medications. Certain exceptions as defined in protocol apply.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Autoimmune disease history with systemic therapy requirements and protocol exceptions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Diagnosis of immunodeficiency or treatment with systemic immunosuppressive medications within 7 days prior to the first dose of study drug. Certain exceptions as defined in protocol apply.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Immunosuppressive medication washout with protocol-defined exceptions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection. Exceptions as defined in protocol apply.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Infection exclusion with protocol-defined exceptions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active interstitial lung disease (ILD) or pneumonitis or a history of ILD or pneumonitis requiring treatment with steroids or other immunosuppressive medications.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex history of ILD/pneumonitis requiring specific treatment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Clinically significant cardiac condition, including myocardial infarction, uncontrolled angina, viral myocarditis, cerebrovascular accident, or other acute uncontrolled heart disease < 3 months prior to enrollment on this trial; left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < 50%; New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class III or IV congestive heart failure; or uncontrolled hypertension; or oxygen saturation <92% on room air.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Multiple combined cardiovascular and physiological parameters with varying timeframes.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active, hemodynamically significant pulmonary embolism within 12 weeks prior to enrollment on this trial.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hemodynamically significant pulmonary embolism requires clinical judgment and a specific timeframe.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery within 4 weeks prior to enrollment on this trial.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Major surgery washout window is not a simple lab or biomarker cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Anti-infectious drug treatments (i.e., antibiotics) within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of study drug.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Antibiotic washout window is not a standard lab or biomarker rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior organ allograft transplantations or allogeneic peripheral blood stem cell (PBSC) or bone marrow (BM) transplantation.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior transplantations exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Stage criteria vary by specific study cohort, and include stage II which falls outside of the primary stage III-IV scope, making a single typed stage check inappropriate.
